question: Which Indian writer wrote the famous book "Mansarovar"?
solution:
the correct answer is __**Premchand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Premchand

 
 
• Premchand, also known as Dhanpat Rai Srivastava, was an Indian author best known for his contemporary Hindustani writing.
 
• He was born on July 31, 1880, and died on October 8, 1936.
 
• Hindi and Urdu social fiction were invented by Premchand.
 
• He was one of the first writers to discuss caste systems, the suffering of working women, and other issues that were prevalent in late 1880s culture.
 
• He is one of the most well-known authors on the Indian continent and is recognised as one of the greatest Hindi authors of the first half of the 20th century. 
 
• He has written various novels, including, Godaan, Karmabhoomi, Gaban, Mansarovar, and Idgah.
 
• In a book titled Soz-e-Watan, he released his first collection of five short stories.
